parameters.query: =WITH gate AS (SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND approval_stage='plan' AND decision='approved') AS allowed), output_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id,output_type,title,structured_data,qa_status) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'image_prompts','Image Prompts','{{$json.payload_sql}}'::jsonb,'pending' FROM gate WHERE allowed RETURNING id), task_update AS (UPDATE content_tasks SET status=CASE WHEN (SELECT allowed FROM gate) THEN 'completed' ELSE 'blocked' END,updated_at=now() WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND task_key='image_prompts'), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'output_stored','Output stored: image_prompts',jsonb_build_object('allowed',(SELECT allowed FROM gate),'output_id',(SELECT id FROM output_insert)))) SELECT (SELECT allowed FROM gate) AS allowed, (SELECT id::text FROM output_insert) AS output_id;
